lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vadaa kar saalaaheeai jis vich vadeeaa vadiaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahi mele taa nadaree aaeeaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa man vasaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar hukam masatak hath dhar vichahu maar kadheeaa buriaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sahi tuthai nau nidh paaeeaa ||18||
lines.translation: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa suchaa aap hoi suchai baithaa aai ||
lines.translation: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭਿਟਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: suche agai rakhion koi na bhitio jaai ||
lines.translation: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਵਿਆ ਲਗਾ ਪੜਣਿ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: suchaa hoi kai jeviaa lagaa paRan salok ||
lines.translation: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਥੀ ਜਾਈ ਸਟਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuhathee jaaee satiaa kis ehu lagaa dokh ||
lines.translation: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੂਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n devataa paanee devataa baisa(n)tar devataa loon ||
lines.translation: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)javaa paaiaa ghirat || taa hoaa paak pavit ||
lines.translation: When the fifth thing, the ghee, is added, then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਗਡਿਆ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਤਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapee siu tan gadiaa thukaa paeeaa tit ||
lines.translation: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that is is spat upon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit mukh naam na oocharahi bin naavai ras khaahi ||
lines.translation: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai tit mukh thukaa paahi ||1||
lines.translation: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਿ ਜੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਨਿੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)d ja(n)meeai bha(n)d ni(n)meeai bha(n)d ma(n)gan veeaahu ||
lines.translation: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engaged and married.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)dahu hovai dosatee bha(n)dahu chalai raahu ||
lines.translation: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)d muaa bha(n)d bhaaleeai bha(n)d hovai ba(n)dhaan ||
lines.translation: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiu ma(n)daa aakheeai jit ja(n)mahi raajaan ||
lines.translation: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)dahu hee bha(n)d oopajai bha(n)dai baajh na koi ||
lines.translation: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bha(n)dai baaharaa eko sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit mukh sadaa saalaaheeai bhaagaa ratee chaar ||
lines.translation: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te mukh oojale tit sachai darabaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa jis naahee so chun kadheeai ||
lines.translation: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਸੰਢੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa aapo aapanaa aape hee lekhaa sa(n)dheeai ||
lines.translation: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਹੰਢੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa rahanaa naahee ait jag taa kaait gaarab ha(n)dheeai ||
lines.translation: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himself in pride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa kisai na aakheeai paR akhar eho bujheeai ||
lines.translation: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲੁਝੀਐ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: moorakhai naal na lujheeai ||19||
lines.translation: Don't argue with fools. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਕੈ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak phikai boliai tan man phikaa hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਕੋ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਦੀਐ ਫਿਕੇ ਫਿਕੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phiko phikaa sadeeai phike phikee soi ||
lines.translation: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is his reputation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਟੀਐ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਫਿਕੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phikaa daragah sateeai muhi thukaa phike paai ||
lines.translation: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਾਣਾ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: phikaa moorakh aakheeai paanaa lahai sajaai ||1||
lines.translation: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu jhoothe paij baahar duneeaa a(n)dar phail ||
lines.translation: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath je naavahi utarai naahee mail ||
lines.translation: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, their filth does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਪਟੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗੁਦੜੁ ਤੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh pat a(n)dar baahar gudaR te bhale sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੇਖਨੑੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinh nehu lagaa rab setee dekhanhe veechaar ||
lines.translation: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਚੁਪ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g hasahi ra(n)g rovahi chup bhee kar jaahi ||
lines.translation: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keep silent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: paravaah naahee kisai keree baajh sache naah ||
lines.translation: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਉਪਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਬੈ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar vaat upar kharach ma(n)gaa jabai dei ta khaahi ||
lines.translation: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਕਲਮ ਏਕਾ ਹਮਾ ਤੁਮੑਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: deebaan eko kalam ekaa hamaa tumhaa mel ||
lines.translation: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shall meet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਲਏ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੀੜਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dar lae lekhaa peeR chhutai naanakaa jiu tel ||2||
lines.translation: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners are crushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2||
